ceiling_reason: a/o initial confound — with only 2 MIDDLE forms (ar, or), r's contribution cannot be fully isolated from the initial atom's influence

FL_HAZ_responder_exclusive.note: Only RESPONDER atoms appear at FL_HAZ

tests.title: ar vs or suffix mode profiles
tests.prediction: ar leans Mode A (specification), or leans Mode B (continuation)
tests.evidence: ar=27.4% Mode A, or=26.6% Mode A — nearly identical (+0.8pp)
tests.interpretation: ar and or have indistinguishable suffix mode profiles; mode is not driven by initial atom choice

tests.title: r-terminal enrichment after state transitions
tests.prediction: r enriched at post-state-change positions, especially AXM→FL transitions
tests.pass_criterion: r post-change rate > 60%, enriched at AXM→FL
tests.evidence: r post-change rate = 72.6% (4th highest, RESPONDER class from C1386). Not AXM→FL specific.
tests.interpretation: Confirms r as RESPONDER but does not distinguish return from respond — all RESPONDER atoms show this

tests.title: r-terminal paragraph position gradient
tests.prediction: Q0 depleted, Q2-Q3 enriched, possibly Q4 declining
tests.pass_criterion: Q2+Q3 enrichment > 1.2x vs Q0, gradient statistically significant
tests.evidence: r-terminal paragraph shape is FLAT (Q0-Q4 all within 0.97-1.03x enrichment). No gradient.
tests.interpretation: r does not have a paragraph-positional gradient; it appears uniformly throughout paragraph bodies

tests.title: r-terminal FLOW category co-occurrence
tests.prediction: FLOW lift > 1.3x, THERMAL lift < 1.0x on lines with r-terminal
tests.evidence: All category lifts near 1.0x (range 0.95-1.05). No preferential FLOW co-occurrence. r does not attract FLOW-category neighbors.
tests.interpretation: r is category-neutral at line level; it does not preferentially co-occur with any specific operational category

tests.title: k→r vs e→r bigram chaining
tests.prediction: If flow: k→r enriched; if return: e→r enriched
tests.pass_criterion: k/e enrichment ratio > 1.3x in either direction
tests.evidence: r→a forward chain at 2.142x (strongest); n→r backward chain at 1.234x; r→r self-chain at 1.865x. Neither k→r nor e→r specifically enriched — instead r chains with iteration-axis atoms (a, n, r).
tests.interpretation: r participates in iteration-axis sequential dependencies, not kernel-specific chains. Supports 'respond' over either 'flow' or 'return'.

tests.title: FL_HAZ macro-state deep dive
tests.prediction: r enriched at FL_HAZ, depleted at AXM
tests.evidence: r at FL_HAZ: 45.34% of terminal atoms (4.910x enrichment, chi-sq=1473.71, p≈0). ALL 248 FL_HAZ r-terminal tokens are 'ar' — zero 'or'. Only r(45.3%), l(34.0%), n(20.7%) appear at FL_HAZ. Responder-exclusive.
tests.interpretation: ar monopolizes FL_HAZ. This is the strongest single signal for r, but it's ar specifically (not or), revealing the a/o initial confound.

tests.title: ar vs or mode by macro-state
tests.prediction: ar Mode A > 55%, or Mode B > 60%
tests.evidence: ar=27.4% Mode A, or=26.6% Mode A (identical). Per-state mode profiles also identical. BUT: ar and or have COMPLETELY DIFFERENT macro-state distributions (ar: 41.8% FL_HAZ; or: 0% FL_HAZ, 70.5% FQ).
tests.interpretation: Mode is not the differentiator — macro-state is. ar and or occupy completely different operational niches despite identical mode signatures.

tests.title: ar vs or line position
tests.evidence: ar mean position: 0.4892, or mean position: 0.4918. Delta: -0.0026. Both perfectly medial.
tests.interpretation: ar and or have identical line positions. Line position does not differentiate r-terminal forms.

tests.title: Kernel profile on ar-lines vs or-lines
tests.prediction: k-kernel higher on ar-lines, h-kernel higher on or-lines
tests.pass_criterion: k delta > +5pp, h delta > +5pp in predicted directions
tests.evidence: k-kernel on ar-lines: 6.12%, or-lines: 5.64% (delta +0.48pp). h-kernel on ar-lines: 6.58%, or-lines: 5.91% (delta +0.67pp). All deltas < 1pp — negligible.
tests.interpretation: Kernel composition of lines is not affected by ar vs or presence. The local kernel environment is identical.

tests.title: r-density vs suffix-mode cycling rate
tests.evidence: rho = -0.334, p = 0.003. More r-terminal tokens in a paragraph = LESS mode alternation, not more. r is the strongest anti-cycling terminal atom.
tests.interpretation: r actively suppresses cycling. This is the opposite of 'repeat' and instead supports 'respond' — r locks the system into sustained response rather than oscillation.
